# Search Mode Delta — Preserve Deliberate Intent

The Awtsmoos gives Hebrew to the whole Torah sea, not to one automatic lane alone;
Awtsmoos.com keeps Library as the unforced home while Tanach and Exact are deliberately known.

## Evidence

- `searchMode.js` exports `LIBRARY_MODE`, `TANACH_MODE`, `EXACT_MODE`, `automaticMode`, `modeFromUrl`, `hasExplicitMode`, and `configureMode`.
- It does not export or define `containsHebrew`.
- `automaticMode()` intentionally returns `LIBRARY_MODE` without inspecting query language.
- `modeFromUrl(values)` returns an explicit valid mode or otherwise `LIBRARY_MODE`.
- The module's own current contract says Hebrew language must not be confused with Tanach intent.
- Repository search finds `containsHebrew` only in the stale test.

## Delta

`searchMode.test.mjs` still asserts the retired behavior that Hebrew automatically selects Tanach and imports a deleted `containsHebrew` helper.

## Exact Rewrite

Rewrite only `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/searchMode.test.mjs` completely:
- assert automatic mode is Library for Hebrew and English queries;
- assert URL hydration defaults to Library when no explicit mode exists;
- assert explicit Library, Tanach, and Exact modes remain respected;
- preserve the Tanach API exact-search and safe result-link contract;
- keep the test <=120 lines.

## NEXT_ACTION

Rewrite the stale test, reread it, run it directly, then run the complete Sefarim suite fail-fast.
